assessment.summary: The concurrency lifecycle is not safe to approve: a locally owned unbuffered channel blocks before any peer can run.

findings.title: A local unbuffered channel blocks before a peer can run

evidence.message: The locally owned unbuffered channel results is used synchronously before any peer can run.

findings.recommendation: Start the peer before the blocking operation, use direct value flow when concurrency is unnecessary, or introduce buffering only when its ownership and capacity are intentional.

findings.title: WaitGroup registration races with the wait lifecycle

evidence.message: workers.Add runs inside the goroutine it is intended to register.

findings.recommendation: Call Add in the launching goroutine before each go statement, then defer Done as the first operation inside the worker.

findings.title: Cancellation ownership is discarded
findings.recommendation: Retain the cancellation function and invoke it on every exit path, and pass the errgroup-derived context to work launched by that group.

opinion.summary: I would fix the deterministic channel deadlock before merging.
